net.canarymod.api.ai

Interface AIManager


  • public interface AIManager
    This class manages AI for Living Entities. Will do nothing for players.
    Author:
    Aaron (somners)

    • Method Detail

      • addTask

        boolean addTask(int priority,
              AIBase ai)
        Adds this instance of the class extending AIBase to be added to the Entity that owns this AIManager.
        Parameters:
        priority - priority of this task. Higher numbers are higher priority.
        ai - The class to add.
        Returns:
        True if it was successfully added, false otherwise.

      • removeTask

        boolean removeTask(Class<? extends AIBase> ai)
        Remove the instance of the class extending AIBase from this entities list of AI.
        Parameters:
        ai - The Class type to remove
        Returns:
        true if successfully removed; false otherwise

      • hasTask

        boolean hasTask(Class<? extends AIBase> ai)
        Checks if the entity that owns this AIManager has an instance of the AIBase of this class type.
        Parameters:
        ai - Class to check.
        Returns:
        true if it already has this ai, false otherwise.

      • getTask

        AIBase getTask(Class<? extends AIBase> ai)
        Get a Task of the specific class type.
        Parameters:
        ai - Class type to check
        Returns:
        the task if it exits, null if it does not.
